
class PDEngine extends AudioWorkletProcessor {
 constructor(){super();this.voices=[];this.jobs=[];this.patch=null;this.tables=null;this.bend=0;this.mod=0;this.limit=8;this.counter=0;this.port.onmessage=e=>this.message(e.data)}
 message(m){if(m.type==='tables')this.tables=m.tables;else if(m.type==='patch'){this.patch=m.patch;for(let v of this.voices){v.p=this.patch;for(let n=0;n<2;n++){v.lines[n].a.def=this.patch.lines[n].amp;v.lines[n].d.def=this.patch.lines[n].dcw;v.lines[n].p.def=this.patch.lines[n].pitch;v.lines[n].freq=440*Math.pow(2,(v.note-69+this.patch.lines[n].oct*12+(n?this.patch.detune/100:0))/12)}}}else if(m.type==='on'){this.jobs.push(m);this.jobs.sort((a,b)=>a.time-b.time)}else if(m.type==='off'){this.jobs.push(m);this.jobs.sort((a,b)=>a.time-b.time)}else if(m.type==='cancel'){this.jobs=this.jobs.filter(j=>!j.seq);for(let v of this.voices)if(v.seq)this.release(v)}else if(m.type==='panic'){this.jobs=[];for(let v of this.voices){v.kill=1;v.killStart=v.fade??1}}else if(m.type==='bend')this.bend=m.value;else if(m.type==='mod')this.mod=m.value;else if(m.type==='poly')this.limit=m.value}
 envStart(def){return {def,stage:0,pos:0,from:0,value:0,released:false,done:false}}
 release(v){if(v.released)return;v.released=true;for(let l of v.lines)for(let e of [l.a,l.d,l.p]){e.released=true;e.from=e.value;e.pos=0;e.stage=e.def.s+1;if(e.stage>7)e.done=true}}
 env(e){if(e.done)return e.value;if(!e.released&&e.stage>e.def.s)return e.value;let pt=e.def.p[e.stage];let samples=Math.max(1,pt[0]*sampleRate);e.pos++;let t=Math.min(1,e.pos/samples);e.value=e.from+(pt[1]-e.from)*t;if(t>=1){e.from=e.value;e.pos=0;e.stage++;if(e.stage>7)e.done=true}return e.value}
 start(m){if(!this.patch||!this.tables)return;const p=this.patch;let live=this.voices.filter(v=>!v.kill);if(live.length>=this.limit){let old=live.find(v=>v.released)||live[0];old.kill=1;old.killStart=old.fade??1}let v={id:m.id,note:m.note,vel:m.velocity,seq:m.seq,phase:[Math.random()*.02,Math.random()*.02],lines:[],released:false,kill:0,fade:0,p};for(let l of p.lines){v.lines.push({a:this.envStart(l.amp),d:this.envStart(l.dcw),p:this.envStart(l.pitch),freq:440*Math.pow(2,(m.note-69+l.oct*12+(v.lines.length?p.detune/100:0))/12),step:0,band:0})}this.voices.push(v);if(this.voices.length>this.limit+16)this.voices.shift()}
 wave(w,depth,band,phase){let x=phase*1024,i=x|0,f=x-i,di=Math.max(0,Math.min(12,depth*12)),d=di|0,a=((w*13+d)*8+band)*1024,b=((w*13+Math.min(12,d+1))*8+band)*1024,j=(i+1)&1023;let v=this.tables[a+i]+(this.tables[a+j]-this.tables[a+i])*f,u=this.tables[b+i]+(this.tables[b+j]-this.tables[b+i])*f;return v+(u-v)*(di-d)}
 process(inputs,outputs){let out=outputs[0],L=out[0],R=out[1]||L;if(!this.tables||!this.patch)return true;const cuts=[400,200,100,50,25,12,6,3];for(let i=0;i<L.length;i++){let time=currentTime+i/sampleRate;if((i&15)===0)this.vib=1+Math.sin(time*6.28318530718*this.patch.vibRate)*(this.patch.vibrato+this.mod*.018);while(this.jobs.length&&this.jobs[0].time<=time){let m=this.jobs.shift();if(m.type==='on')this.start(m);else for(let v of this.voices)if(v.id===m.id)this.release(v)}let left=0,right=0;for(let vi=this.voices.length-1;vi>=0;vi--){let v=this.voices[vi],p=v.p,s0=0,s1=0;v.fade=Math.min(1,v.fade+1/(sampleRate*.004));if(v.kill){v.kill+=1;if(v.kill>sampleRate*.008){this.voices.splice(vi,1);continue}}let fade=v.kill?Math.max(0,1-v.kill/(sampleRate*.008))*v.killStart:v.fade;
for(let n=0;n<2;n++){let l=v.lines[n],spec=p.lines[n],a=this.env(l.a),d=this.env(l.d),pe=this.env(l.p);if((i&15)===0||!l.step){let freq=l.freq*Math.pow(2,(this.bend+(pe-.5)*p.pitchDepth)/12)*this.vib;let max=sampleRate/(freq*2.3);l.band=0;while(l.band<7&&cuts[l.band]>max)l.band++;l.step=freq/sampleRate}let band=l.band;v.phase[n]+=l.step;if(v.phase[n]>=1)v.phase[n]%=1;let depth=spec.depth*d;let s=this.wave(spec.wave,depth,band,v.phase[n]);if(spec.wave2>=0)s=(s+this.wave(spec.wave2,depth,band,v.phase[n]))*.5;if(n===0)s0=s*a*spec.level;else s1=s*a*spec.level;}
let x=p.mode===0?s0:p.mode===1?s1:p.mode===3?s0*s1*1.5:(s0+s1)*.65;let ring=s0*s1*2;x=x*(1-p.ring)+ring*p.ring;if(p.noise)x+=(Math.random()*2-1)*p.noise*v.lines[0].a.value;let amp=v.vel*.18*fade;let pan=(v.note%7-3)*.025;left+=x*amp*(1-pan);right+=x*amp*(1+pan);if(v.released&&v.lines.every(l=>l.a.done||l.a.value<.00005&&l.a.released&&l.a.stage>6))this.voices.splice(vi,1)}L[i]=left;R[i]=right}
if(++this.counter%16===0)this.port.postMessage({type:'voices',count:this.voices.length});return true}
}
registerProcessor('cz-pd-engine',PDEngine);
